CP1320 passed 140 tests including sequential Restaurant swipes; later CP1322 suite had 135 passed and only 5 identical failures caused by an outdated expected SVG path in the visual test, corrected in CP1323. Swipe business logic unchanged. CP1326 updates next Meal card identity synchronously when the active deck selection changes and fences async preview completion by render generation plus meal ID.
